senses.gloss: The maxim intends to paint a picture of a situation when mutually opposite things come together. The idol of Gaṇeśa is a combination of an elephant and a man. The elephant and the lion partially occupy the bodies of Gaṇeśa and Narasimha partially. The theory of Anekānta of the Jainas is a set of many opposite concepts like is and is not. --सा० 707
